Sehhaty is an electronic platform of health services for individuals in Saudi Arabia. Sehhaty aims to enable users to reach health information and medical e-services provided by different health organization in the Kingdom, such as: vital signs updates, tracking prescribed medicine, retrieving and sharing medical leaves, promoting healthy lifestyle, and other services related to the health of individuals and families and the health awareness. \n\n Sehhaty is provided under the supervision of the Ministry of Health in Saudi Arabia, in line with its vision to improve the standards of healthcare and develop its services.
